title: .audit report front matter
description: Required metadata at the top of every .audit/reports/*.md report. Encodes the rule from SS 9 of the session's architecture decision: 'audit(commit X) != permanent certification of the repository'. A report without targetCommit, or whose targetCommit the caller cannot verify against the candidate (allowing only a diff limited to .audit/** and STATUS.md), must never be accepted as current evidence by release-gate or ai-native status.

isMergeGate.description: .audit is never a merge gate (preserved from TEMPLATE v2.0.5's own AUDIT_RULES.md); it is a release/milestone gate only, applied via release-gate.
